### Helper models

Models this attack drives, configured under its `roles`. Each one is a [ModelConfig](../../cli/campaign-files/target.md#modelconfig).

| Role | Kind | Needed | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attacker` | chat model | required | Rewrites the goal once per persuasion technique (logical appeal, authority, …). |

### Parameters

Settings for the algorithm itself, written under the attack's `parameters`. Anything left out keeps its default.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `techniques` | string or list of string | `top5` | `"top5"` (the paper's five most effective), `"all"` (all 40), or a list of taxonomy technique names, tried in order. |
| `max_techniques` | integer (>= 0) | `0` | Upper bound on techniques tried per goal; 0 tries every selected technique. |

### In a campaign file

```yaml
attacks:
- name: pap
  roles:
    attacker:
      name: llama3.2
      connection:
        provider: ollama
        type: OLLAMA
```

:::note[Needs a helper model]

This attack cannot run without `attacker`. A campaign that leaves it out fails to resolve, before anything is attacked.

:::
